opening.argument: The recording is presented as documentation of repeated calls described as scams, with the interaction used to test whether the caller was genuine. The caller claims to represent Microsoft, seeks a “connection to external computer,” and demands 25 euros for registration. Those details are captured as the subject of the investigation, not as the video's own solicitation. The speaker explicitly says, “I just wanted to see whether you were genuine” and characterizes the exchange as an attempt to scam him while he wastes the caller's time. Its purpose is therefore to expose and test the purported scam call.

citations.quote: After I have been called by scammers for the second time, I used my daughter's camera setup to record this.
I just wanted to see whether you were genuine
I'm calling you from windows operating systems on behalf of Microsoft Corporation
